scope: Fresh baseline iPad mini screenshots captured in this run; four selected originals inspected, plus two contact sheets. Historical capture names retained by unchanged tests.

findings.observation: Review begins with source/XML/version details and compatibility text; saving action is below the initial viewport.
findings.improvement: Promote change summary, collapse technical metadata, fix the primary action to the bottom.

findings.observation: Saving only the local copy presents generic 完成/好 alert. The next export action remains behind the dismissed alert in the operation list.
findings.improvement: Continue directly into export for default action; show saved-for-later state inline for secondary action.

findings.observation: The export sheet labels its close button 完成 even before a target has been selected or files written.
findings.improvement: Use explicit return/later navigation before export and reserve completion wording for successful export.

findings.observation: The library clearly displays 已保存，待导出, but only offers 打开这份副本, requiring another review/export navigation.
findings.improvement: Ensure the reopened copy provides prominent 继续导出 without requiring another save.
